items.title: Carmen Leggio interviewed by Monk Rowe, Tarrytown, New York, October 31, 1998
items.q: I just saw John Mosca took it over now. And I just saw them about a month ago... I went down because I knew he was there

ctx.x: Did you still have the steady Monday night thing at the Vanguard or was that—

Yeah that’s still there. I just saw John Mosca took it over now. And I just saw them about a month ago, because I hadn’t been to the city for a long time but I went down because I knew he was there and they just went to Tunisia of all places, Tunisia and someplace else I forget. But they’re still there on Monday nights, yeah.
Did you have the chance to travel overseas?
